note: Johnson County Agricultural Association, on the fairgrounds. Sites tight, pick a perimeter site for a 23-ft rig. Big rigs use Worthsville Rd exit. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30 on Firefly and the operator's page. Added 50A, sewer, 84 sites to 60 ft, pull-throughs, showers/dump, Apr 1-Oct 31 with the fair gap. Note cleaned. Ownership flag: association, reads as private.
flags: OWNERSHIP: stored local, but I read the operator as NOT a government: `private`. The page's own term is 'Fair Association' with paid members who nominate from the floor at an annual meeting and elect a Board of Directors ('Members must have paid membership by July 31, 2026 in order to be nominated from the floor at the annual meeting'). I did not find its corporate filing (ProPublica's nonprofit search returned nothing for it) and the site never says who holds title to the grounds, so the legal form is inferred from that page. If moved to private, the $50 gate passes at $30; no gateway needed.

PUBLIC NIGHT: yes. Ordinary transient nights outside fair week at a published rate, Firefly online with $30 on 78 available sites for a 23-ft Class C on May 10, 2027. Not event-only. Presence: operator page, phone 317-738-3247. RV Life 4 stars, $$.

FIT: Firefly 'Fits RVs up to 60 ft' on 83 sites, 36 on site 1. The stored 'sites tight' caveat has no operator source; imagery shows angled pads tightly herringboned in rows, which fits it, so I kept it.
PIN: 39.48364,-86.06897 sits on the lawn about 60-80 m north of the angled RV rows, fine. 'not waterfront' stands, no water.
WEBSITE: the stored website has two lines (operator page + Firefly). The Firefly link moves to booking.url; the page line can stay alone.
